subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: 2D shapes and symmetry

show.line: Fold the butterfly down the middle. Both sides match. That fold line is a line of symmetry!

rounds.prompt: Which shape is cut by its line of symmetry? Both halves must match.

rounds.praise: Yes! The heart is the same on both sides.

rounds.prompt: Look at the big letter. Fold it down the middle. Do the sides match? Say yes or no.
Finish the picture. Which half makes it symmetrical?
Symmetrical or not? Put each shape in its group.
How many lines of symmetry does a square have? Tap the picture.
rounds.praise: Yes! A square has four lines of symmetry.

hints: Imagine folding it. Do the two halves sit exactly on top of each other?
The line of symmetry cuts the shape into two matching halves.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will draw a line of symmetry on the rectangle.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I drew it from one corner, across to the other corner!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Fold on that line and the halves do not match. Go straight across the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's fold it together. Straight across the middle. Now the halves match!

parent_line: Can spot symmetrical shapes and draw a line of symmetry.
